notes.title: Build 10 : Test build 21.
notes.content:
Hello all, quick build here to address some game loading issues.

Changed:
- Moved the rick roll (:<
- Improved world gen.

Added:
- Added setting in VR to disable build particle effects.
- Added load status to loading screen.

Patched:
- Patched a bug where people and cars would not be removed if the road under them was.

What's to come. I am working on adding leap motion support in preparation for the lynx build so if you have a leap motion sitting around you will be able to play CVR with hand tracking.

notes.title: Build 10 : Test build 20.
notes.content:
Hello all! Work has been very slow but I have been able to patch many bugs. I have also worked on some other bits such as the airports, car behaviour and VR.

Added:
- Added tile detail to ariports.

Changed:
- Updated VR line builder.
- Updated line builder so some tiles cannot be placed e.g. tiles bigger than 1x1.
- Improved cars so they dont overlap as much. 

Patched:
- Patched the mock phone offset. 
- Patched a bug where cars would get stuck and float towards ramps with lower FPS. 
- Patched a bug where cargo ships would stop each other from getting to the docks. 
- Patched a bug where tiles would be placed under ground when the line builder would pass through cliffs. 
- Patched a bug where power would not be removed from buildings using power directly from source.
- Patched a bug where waste pipes would not use water on network.
- Patched a bug where buildings would keep power after having source removed. 
- Patched a bug where a building would be without power but would not get abandoned. 
- Patched a bug related to world loading.
- Patched a bug where the player could place some tiles over water. 
- Patched lag when placing tiles via the line builder. 
- Patched lag related to requirements. 
- Patched lag related to placing buildings.

notes.title: Build 10 : Test build 19.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For todays build I have been working on the waste system. It works a lot better now! I have also stomped out a number of bugs.

Waste can now overflow onto land and cause tiles to become polluted so think about waste pipe placement when routing your cities waste. If too many waste tiles are over one water tile it will start moving onto land.

New canal waste movement:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/371d0eda7a0dd3ae192ab14d7724196342e73efe.gif[/img]

Waste movement on land:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/1d05a3207b3ce184a5d0aa99daf0dad77abc5665.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/1d05a3207b3ce184a5d0aa99daf0dad77abc5665.gif[/img][/url]

Waste overflow:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/e1b2c7f4ec8e488991935770ecbc49b03726fa76.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/e1b2c7f4ec8e488991935770ecbc49b03726fa76.gif[/img][/url]

Added:
- Added it so waste can now overflow onto land.
- Added canal waste flow.

Changed:
- Arrow camera speed.

Patched:
- Patched a bug where water falls would show on canal tiles at wrong time.
- Patched a new bug related the removal of trees/rocks.
- Patched a bug where waste would clump at one location.
- Patched a bug where pipes would be placed on land.
- Patched a bug where buildings would not be added to power/water grids.
- Patched a bug where waste pipes would make waste when there were no buildings to produce it.
- Patched a bug where pipes would not be shown when placing water related tiles.
- Patched a bug where the line builder would make odd slopes.

There are very few bugs left now(Ones I have found) and as I said last update there are very few things left to add for this build. Build 10 should be fully done within the next 2-3 test builds depending on how things go. CVR development speed might slow down since I have just gotten to my Uni and so I will have new work on my plate in addition to my other projects.

Be sure to check out the discord pinned on the community page!

notes.title: Build 10 : Test build 18.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I have a big update for today. I have added the new airport system.

Plane and the airport:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/180c84dd6b2428b2544faa3e0185f15a45a6cc22.png[/img]

Throwing planes in VR:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42325492/93cb63547910f843a06448e297d6f32b10bd5cb3.gif[/img]

Added:
 - Airports.
 - Planes.

Patched:
 - A bug where trees and rocks would not be removed on some tiles.
 - A bug where boats would get stuck on some maps.
 - Two bugs related to rubble on saving chunks.
 - A bug where the table adjust would conflict with the timebox.

We are getting closer and closer to the end of B10! There are only a few things left to add and patch before the build is fully done. Once done we can move onto B11, that build is going to be fun!

I will be reworking the main menus, working on the chunk system, adding terrain edit tools and I will even be working on porting CVR to the Lynx-r1! There are many other things I will be working on B11 that I have not covered here, if you want to learn more you can find me on the discord server or you can take a look at the road map(does not cover everything).

notes.title: Build 10 : Test build 15.
notes.content:
Hello! This build I have mainly been working on patching bugs but I was able to add one of the VR tools to the flatscreen mode of the game.

Added:
 - Pollution cleaning tool to desktop

Patched:
 - Dev textures on roads
 - Table adjustment
 - Removed sound system for now
 - World lights with weather system
 - waste on network icon not showing on some tiles
 - cleaning tool removing some roads

That's all for now, next few builds are going to be focused on bugs so that I can get a somewhat playable demo out for NextFest and SteamVRFest. Once I'm done with bugs I will be working on B10 features.
